117647.name: Upper Midwest Merkos - Lubavitch House
117647.note: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 17 May 2016): 'It's been 55 years since Rabbi Moshe and Mindelle Feller set out to found Upper Midwest Merkos–Chabad Lubavitch in Minnesota in the winter of 1961, a mere month after their marriage.' Mindelle Feller's obituary (CrownHeights.info, 6 Dec 2017): she moved there with her husband 'to found Chabad-Lubavitch of Minnesota in 1961'. Medium: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 24 Jan 2012, 'Marking Half a Century') says 'That was in 1962'. Homes (2016 article): 'After two years of living in the rabbi's father's house in Minneapolis', St. Paul; 'In 1965, the Fellers opened the Lubavitch House in a 12-room home'; it 'was burned by arsonists in 1968', then 'a mansion in Highland Park'; 'In 2000, Chabad again relocated to a new 23,000-square-foot facility in West St. Paul' (400 Marie Ave. W.).

earlier.where: the Lubavitch House, a 12-room home in St. Paul (burned by arsonists in 1968)
a mansion in Highland Park, St. Paul

117536.name: Chabad Lubavitch Jewish Educational Center (Lubavitch Cheder Day School)
117536.note: This listing is the Lubavitch Cheder Day School (the same phone, 651-698-0556; Wikipedia: 'Lubavitch Cheder Day School a.k.a. Chabad Lubavitch Jewish Educational Center'). Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 17 May 2016): 'in 1977, the time came to found a Chassidic day school in St. Paul, and Lubavitch Cheder Day School was born, with Mrs. Feller serving as founding principal.' eJewishPhilanthropy (Chabad.org, 2017): 'The school was founded in 1977 by a handful of Chabad families'; Rabbi Shlomo and Chavie Bendet 'came to the Twin Cities the year the day school was started' and grew it 'from its beginnings in the basement of the local Lubavitch House to a trailer-turned-classroom, and eventually, to the building it is today'. The Chinuch Office directory (2023-24): 'Founded: 1977', 1758 Ford Parkway (as in the Sept 2011 lubavitch.com directory); lubavitch.com now gives 1810 Montreal Ave.

earlier.where: the basement of the Lubavitch House

117646.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Southern Minnesota
117646.note: U.S. House guest chaplain page (prayer of 12 July 2005), Rep. Gil Gutknecht: 'Since 1988 Rabbi Greene has served as the Lubavitcher Rebbe's Emissary to Rochester, more specifically, to the Mayo Clinic.' At 730 Second Street SW in the Sept 2011 lubavitch.com directory (Wayback), as today.

117988.name: Chabad-Lubavitch Mikvah Information
117988.note: No year of its own. Rabbi Gershon Grossbaum's mikvah-information office at 1816 Rome Avenue, St. Paul, in the Sept 2011 lubavitch.com directory (Wayback); the AJW community directory lists 1816 Rome Ave. as the 'Chabad Lubavitch Mitzva Campaign' (mikva@juno.com). He heads the St. Paul Mikvah Association (TC Jewfolk, 25 Feb 2025). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

118224.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Minneapolis
118224.note: TC Jewfolk (10 Sept 2025): 'Rabbi and Rivka Grossbaum ran the Chabad summer camp in St. Paul in 1995 and then moved to Minnetonka to start the Minneapolis Chabad center in Elul of that year' (Aug-Sept 1995). 'For decades, Chabad of Minneapolis had been tucked away on Hedberg Drive in Minnetonka' (2845 Hedberg Dr., AJW directory); its new Chabad Center for Jewish Life on Hillside Lane (11033 Hillside Lane W) was in use from November 2024 and its ribbon was cut on September 3, 2025.

118314.name: Chabad of St. Louis Park
118314.note: No founding year found. Dr. Yosef Y. Shagalow's Chabad of St. Louis Park at 2834 Raleigh Avenue in the Dec 2009 lubavitch.com directory (Wayback); today's listing shows no street. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

118380.name: Chabad of Duluth, MN
118380.note: lubavitch.com (24 Dec 2003): Duluth's mayor proclaimed 'Chabad Week' and saluted 'Chabad Lubavitch of Northern Minnesota for its vital work in Duluth throughout the past two years' (so about 2001). In the Dec 2009 lubavitch.com directory (Wayback) the Duluth listing was Chabad Lubavitch of Northern Minnesota, 332 North 34th Avenue E, Rabbi Boruch Greenwald. Rabbi Mendy and Tirtza Ross, the directors now, were to move 'shortly after the conclusion of the Sukkot holiday' of 2018 as Duluth's 'new Chabad representatives' (lubavitch.com, 14 Sept 2018); their site still names the corporation 'Chabad Lubavitch of Northern Minnesota' (5003 London Rd). Medium: a count back, and whether the center ran without a break from 2003 to 2018 isn't shown.

earlier.where: 332 North 34th Avenue East, Duluth (Rabbi Boruch Greenwald)

118506.name: Chabad Lubavitch Education
118506.note: No year of its own: Rabbi Mendel Feller's education program, a department of Upper Midwest Merkos (117647) on chabad.org; at 270 Sherwood Court, West St. Paul, in the Sept 2011 lubavitch.com directory (Wayback). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

119759.name: Chabad Oneg Shabbos V'Yomtov
119759.note: The AJW community directory (posted March 2013, last changed Dec 2015, archived April 2016): 'For more than 20 years, Oneg Shabbos V'Yom Tov has brought relief to needy families in the Twin Cities' (food packages, help for Russian immigrants, scholarships, needy brides and grooms), at 400 Marie Ave. W. (Lubavitch House), so it began before 1995. Today's directory still has the same words. A department of Upper Midwest Merkos (117647) on chabad.org; its listing is in the first online directory (2004).

684361.name: It's Good To Know
684361.note: Rabbi Manis Friedman's nonprofit (itsgoodtoknow.org); its own site gives no year. IRS: 'Its Good To Know Inc' (Brooklyn, NY), exempt since April 2005 (ProPublica's IRS data), so it existed by then. Its chabad.org listing went up June 4 2008.

1096297.name: Chabad U of M - The Rohr Center for Jewish Student Life
1096297.note: TC Jewfolk (5 Sept 2025): Rabbi Yitzi and Chavi Steiner 'started Chabad at the University of Minnesota, which celebrates its 15th anniversary of being on campus this year'; the U of M had no Chabad, though the rest of the Big Ten 'at that time – 2010' had one. Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 17 2010. Now 1121 University Avenue SE.

1560476.name: Chabad of Greater St. Paul
1560476.note: Its own About page (posted 4 Dec 2011, read through Firecrawl): 'Rabbi Zalman & Nechama founded Chabad of Greater S. Paul in the fall of 2011.' Its chabad.org listing went up July 1 2011. The AJW directory gives 998 Stratford Road, Mendota Heights.

2027612.name: Chabad Jewish Center of North Dakota
2027612.note: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 28 May 2025): 'When she and her husband, Rabbi Yonah Grossman, moved to Fargo in 2011'; Valley News Live (5 Dec 2021): 'Rabbi Yonah and his wife Esti Grossman moved to Fargo in 2011 to open the Chabad Jewish Center'. Medium: Lubavitch.com (on CrownHeights.info, 21 Nov 2012) calls them the Grossmans 'who have recently moved to Fargo', announced at that month's Kinus, and the chabad.org listing went up Nov 6 2012. Now 1234 Broadway N.

3368473.name: Chabad Young Professionals Uptown Minneapolis
3368473.note: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 12 Jan 2017): Rabbi Sholom and Mushky Brook, 'co-directors of the Uptown Chabad of Minneapolis and its Chabad Young Professionals group', were asked by Rabbi Mordechai Grossbaum to start it; 'The couple received the go-ahead in March; a few months later, they made the move' (March 2016, so mid-2016). Its chabad.org listing went up Aug 18 2016.

3451535.name: Chabad Jewish Center of South Dakota
3451535.note: JTA (in the St. Louis Jewish Light, 27 Dec 2016): 'Rabbi Mendel and Mussie Alperowitz and their children arrived on Dec. 24 in Sioux Falls, where they will open a Chabad center.' Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 16 2016. Now 4901 S Isabel Pl, Suite 200.

5228285.name: Chabad of Macalester-Groveland
5228285.note: No start date found. COLlive (29 Dec 2022): 'Chabad of Macalester-Groveland is Minnesota's newest Chabad House', Rabbi Tzemach and Mushky Feller, for St. Paul's campuses; before it, students came to Lubavitch House in West St. Paul. AJW directory: 1546 Portland Ave. Its chabad.org listing went up Sept 14 2021, so it existed by then.

5316650.name: Chabad of Maple Grove
5316650.note: Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 4 April 2022): 'Rabbi Nissi Naparstek moved to Maple Grove, Minnesota, last November' (Nov 2021); 'The Naparsteks have only been in Minnesota for four months'. Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 18 2021.

6150594.name: The Gan Rochester Preschool
6150594.note: Rochester Post Bulletin (2 Sept 2022): 'Greene opened the doors of the lower level of her southwest Rochester home in October 2020 as a family child care center called The Gan.' Chana Greene directs it, as part of Chabad of Southern Minnesota (117646). Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 1 2023.

7417922.name: Chabad of Eden Prairie
7417922.note: TC Jewfolk (31 Aug 2026): 'A new Chabad is launching in Eden Prairie'; Rabbi Schneur and Sheina Matusof will lead it; 'The idea came to the couple in April'; Rosh Hashanah 2026 programs planned. Its chabad.org listing went up July 22 2026.
